crossRefs.note: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and…
that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.
For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it…
This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom…

translations.web: It will turn out as a testimony for you.
translations.bsb: This will be your opportunity to serve as witnesses.
translations.kjv: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
translations.asv: It shall turn out unto you for a testimony.
